alt: 母親耐心勸說急著出門騎車的孩子，輕扶他的肩膀並拿著安全帽，孩子停下來聽她叮嚀。
scene_prompt: 苦口婆心 means caring and tireless sincere persuasion, not scolding or offering something bitter. Contemporary cozy home entryway on a sunny day. A concerned middle-aged mother sits face-to-face at eye level with her older child who wants to rush outside on a bicycle without a helmet. Mother patiently continues explaining safety: one hand gently touches the child's forearm, the other offers a correctly shaped simple cycle helmet with two clear straps. Her expression shows deep loving concern and a little weariness from repeated reminders, mouth speaking kindly, never yelling. The child still looks impatient, with arms naturally resting, but has stopped and is beginning to listen. Bicycle stands stationary outside the doorway leaning safely on its kickstand, its TWO wheels and pedals anatomically mechanically correct, no rider. A pair of cycling gloves and water bottle neatly ready nearby suggest the repeated attempt to prepare. Only mother and child, natural bodies and exactly two arms and legs each, realistic supported sitting poses and correct hands. No text or bubbles. Main focus on mother's earnest mouth and face, patient persuasive hand gesture, safety helmet, child's reluctant attention. This is persistent caring advice, no punishment or threatening stance.
